text: “You shouldn’t say such things,” Peter retorted. “Of course I’m very sorry, but how could I know you were in the drawer?” Wendy was not listening to him. “O Peter,” she cried, “if she would only stand still and let me see her!” “They hardly ever stand still,” he said, but for one moment Wendy saw the romantic figure come to rest on the cuckoo clock. “O the lovely!” she cried, though Tink’s face was still distorted with passion. “Tink,” said Peter amiably, “this lady says she wishes you were her fairy.” Tinker Bell answered insolently.
